question: Did Broadcom's Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue beat the guidance it gave on its Q2 FY2026 call, and by how much in dollars and percent?
grading: Beat amount ±$0.1B; beat % ±0.5pp; must benchmark against the company's AI semiconductor revenue guide
answer: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7 billion versus its Q2-release guidance of $16.0 billion: a $0.7 billion beat, or 4.375% of guidance. [G18-E1, G18-E2]

output.answer:
**Yes — Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue came in above the guidance given on the Q2 FY2026 call.**

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Guidance (given on Q2 FY2026 call, June 3, 2026) | **$16.0 billion** AI semiconductor revenue for Q3 FY2026 |
| Actual Q3 FY2026 result | **$16.7 billion** AI semiconductor revenue (more than tripled YoY) |
| Beat | **+$0.7 billion** |
| Beat in percent | **~4.4%** above guidance |

Notes on context:
- Q2 FY2026 itself delivered $10.8 billion in AI semiconductor revenue (+143% YoY), and management guided Q3 to $16 billion (over 200% YoY growth) — that guidance was modestly below analyst consensus of ~$16.36 billion.
- Along with the Q3 beat, Broadcom raised its full-year FY2026 AI revenue outlook to ~$58 billion (up 186% YoY), above its prior $56 billion guidance, and guided Q4 FY2026 AI revenue to $21.7 billion.

Sources:
- [Broadcom Q2 FY2026 earnings call transcript / highlights (guidance $16B)](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AVGO/earnings/AVGO-Q2-2026-earnings_call-581106.html)
- [Broadcom Q3 FY2026 earnings call transcript (actual $16.7B, FY26 raised to $58B)](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AVGO/earnings/AVGO-Q3-2026-earnings_call-685349.html)
- [Broadcom Q2 FY2026 press release (guidance details)](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/broadcom-inc-announces-second-quarter-201500695.html)
